name: port-function
description: Implement one hydroloom Python function from its description, with two independent reviews, a bounded fix loop, a maintainer handoff, and a milestone Log entry

steps.prompt: Moment: readiness. Function {{function}}. Description {{description}}. Manifest cases {{cases}}. Check the per-function gate and do not edit files. Finish with send_message severity success if the gate holds, severity error naming the first missing item otherwise.

Function {{function}}. Description {{description}}. Cases {{cases}}. Base commit {{base}}. If .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/findings.md exists this is a fix round: address every blocker and should and record a response per id. Otherwise implement from the description. Run pixi run lint and pixi run test. Write the PR body to .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/pr-body.md and commit with the Assisted-by trailer. This run is unattended: do not stop to report progress or ask whether to continue. Finish with send_message severity success when lint and test pass.

branches.prompt: Function {{function}}. Review the diff of the current branch against base commit {{base}} (git diff {{base}}...HEAD). Read the diff before anything else. Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/findings-style.md and end your final message with the VERDICT line.

Moment: review. Function {{function}}. Description {{description}}. Cases {{cases}}. Read the description before the diff, then review the diff of the current branch against base commit {{base}} (git diff {{base}}...HEAD). Write .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/findings-spec.md and end your final message with the VERDICT line.

steps.prompt: Mode: merge. Function {{function}}. Merge .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/findings-style.md and findings-spec.md into .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/findings.md using the three bins. End your final message with VERDICT: APPROVED or VERDICT: REVISE.

Mode: handoff. Function {{function}}. Write the maintainer handoff to .kiro/workflow-output/{{function}}/handoff.md from the PR body at {{artifacts.prbody}} and the merged findings at {{artifacts.findings}}: the PR body, the description bin, the idiom bin, and whether the exemplar or a named kernel is involved.

Mode: record. Function {{function}}. Milestone {{milestone}}. Base commit {{base}}. Implementer effort {{effort}}. Append one Log entry to dev/milestones/{{milestone}}.md from {{artifacts.prbody}}, {{artifacts.findings}}, {{artifacts.handoff}}, and git log {{base}}..HEAD. Every disposition is a dash. Write nothing else in that file. Finish with send_message severity error if you cannot establish both the base and the head SHA.
